purpose: Final-runtime V2 ordinary repeating-ASCII write latency follow-up; original audited baseline reused; no new browser/timing runs
units: milliseconds except explicit traceMicroseconds; counts are integers

method.sampleId: stage/count/variant/repetition/writeIndex plus exact animationId; captureIndex indexes ordinary latency.presentations and captures
method.clock: Start trace clock is exact identified presentation ts minus recorded sample.milliseconds; parse/render boundary endpoints validated against ordinary presentation record within 0.05ms. Source measure b/e pairs retain name+pid+tid+id2 identity. Each renderer frame is contained in AnimationFrame with exact presentation animationId.
method.split: writeToParseEnd + parseEndToRenderBegin + renderToBoundaryEnd + boundaryEndToAck = latency (validated to 0.05ms). Inclusive packing/upload/submit union components explain renderToBoundaryEnd; residual is other renderer work. Medians of components do not add to the latency median.
method.packing: Before ghostty JS rebuildRows; after ZigFrameBuilder.build includes JS options packing plus synchronous WASM native bridge; native-only call is not instrumented. xterm _updateModel is an equivalent model-work control, not the same instance producer.
method.scheduling: previousBoundaryToWrite uses nearest preceding main-thread AnimationFrame::Render b; requestToFire matches exact callback ID containing chosen draw; earlier draws count terminal 0 only; xterm submissions are individual drawElementsInstanced calls, not frame count.
method.quantiles: p50 middle-two average, p95 nearest rank; pooled = all 384 writes, headline = median of four per-run p50s. Representatives nearest per-run p50. Presentation ACK is on-demand headless-shell, not physical vsync.
method.zeroDurationSpans: Chrome ph=n source measures with args.startTime are zero-duration spans, counted once
method.phase: Elapsed since preceding AnimationFrame::Render modulo measured refreshPeriod; approximate sampling phase, with absent idle callbacks and boundary jitter limiting precision
method.headlineDecomposition: Sort four runs by write p50, choose central two; average the splits of each run's two central latency-ordered samples. These four source samples define the headline, avoiding medians of independently ordered components. clockAlignmentResidual exposes sub-0.05ms Chrome performance/trace timestamp alignment differences, making the selected-cohort additive total exact.
method.followup: V2-only trace parsing reuses original before1/before17 audited ledgers and exact-ID representatives from frozen V1 JSON. Both complete V2 matrices are required.

limitations: Ordinary samples are not time-paired before/after; separate sessions can have different sample phase mixtures.

Write batch sequentially awaits screencast colored glyph before launching next sample; captures prove glyph correctness while endpoint is Chrome presentation identity. Sampling phase can move as ACK/capture/driver scheduling changes.
Comparison traces serialize source measures after sampling; span timestamp positions reflect recorded historical performance timestamps.

Native build status/result, missing-glyph registration itself, producer full flag and changed range counts are not directly recorded. Multiple build calls/rebuildRows/no-submit frames provide route evidence but cannot identify every internal condition.
No native-only timing span; build inclusive duration must not be described as exclusively native CPU.
No physical display-vsync/GPU execution claim from these headless-shell hardware traces.
V2 is repeating-ASCII marker latency evidence; realistic rolling-output-only headline fixtures are not part of this comparison.

evidenceRole: Secondary repeating-ASCII latency proof; realistic rolling headline matrices are output-only and retain separate fixture/driver identities
sourceEvidenceReadingPhase: Final runtime V2 source cross-check. Raw V2 manifest source/bundle hashes identify the frozen timing treatment; analysis-time source hashes identify inspected files.

diagnosis.status: Existing ordinary samples only; no new timing runs
diagnosis.evidenceRole: Secondary repeating-ASCII latency proof; realistic rolling headline matrices are output-only and retain separate fixture/driver identities

scrollPathway.payload: Cursor home plus eight colored # characters; no LF or wrap at 40 columns
scrollPathway.source: Session emits scroll only when its scrollback/viewport/scrollbar snapshot changes; cursor position is excluded. Repeated marker samples should avoid rolling-output scroll handling.
scrollPathway.limitation: notifyScroll, full option and uploaded byte lengths are not directly recorded in ordinary latency spans; this is a latency-only follow-up, not a rolling-output byte claim.

diagnosis.nativeTiming: After build timing includes JS options packing plus synchronous native call; original before packing is JS rebuildRows. No native-only span.

verification.assertions: Exact representative ACK identities, containing animation frames, source sequences, sample counts, additive splits and route/frame invariants pass; xterm model work is a snapshot span.
